lessons.symptom_summary: repair-priority autonomous retraining can remain inactive because current rule fingerprints are omitted, while multiple model needs can contend with long collection workloads and invalid post-training artifacts need controller-level rollback verification
lessons.fix_pattern: bind repair-neural status/training to current verified rule fingerprints; permit at most one allowlisted trainer per cycle only under observed normal CPU/memory pressure; apply success/failure cooldowns; preserve corrupt state fail-closed; validate post-training model artifacts and restore the last valid local model on invalid replacement; profile KR/JP/US coverage and source health without inventing market direction; emit unmet capability needs only as non-executable evidence-backed PR proposals
